create_connection: create a SQLite database connection to a specified database file for Droidlet command storage
create_all_tables: create all six SQLite tables for commands, tags, bridge, errors, survey results, and object annotations
saveAndFetchCommands: save a new command with action dict, chat message, username, and tags to the database
onlyFetchCommands: fetch commands from the database filtered by tag or chat message keyword search query
saveAnnotatedErrorToDb: save an annotated parsing error with error type, chat message, action dict, and feedback to the database
